images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of Muon-RT. (a) Each hidden matrix maintains student weights𝐖S\mathbf{W}_{S}and EMA-teacher weights𝐖T\mathbf{W}_{T}, eliminating Muon’s momentum buffer𝐌\mathbf{M}. (b) Newton–Schulz approximately orthogonalizes the gradient𝐆\mathbf{G}into𝐎\mathbf{O}. The radial component of the teacher–student displacement𝐖T−𝐖S\mathbf{W}_{T}-\mathbf{W}_{S}is removed to obtain𝐇\mathbf{H}, which is spectrally normalized into𝐏\mathbf{P}. The update combines both directions as𝐔=(1−α)​𝐎+α​𝐏\mathbf{U}=(1-\alpha)\mathbf{O}+\alpha\mathbf{P}. (c) The EMA-teacher tracks the student’s parameter trajectory with a temporal lag.
